title: Tasks #465: rule for workflowStatus vs progress
description: Decision: docs/design/DECISIONS.md #23. Spec base: /data/PROJECT/IETF/specs/draft-ietf-jmap-tasks-06.txt; editor's source /data/GIT/jmapio-jmap spec/tasks/*.mdown; Mark's item on github.com/jmapio/jmap (gh issue view/pr view <n> -R jmapio/jmap). Prior crate audit: JMAP-t8ej.17. Issue #465: workflowStatus and progress overlap with no rule for which wins. Pick the rule Mark proposed in the issue (ask Mark if the issue leaves it open), write it into the draft bead, and enforce it in handle_task_set with tests. Size S-M.
notes:
Audit JMAP-jkl8.1 (docs/audits/2026-11-19-jkl8.1/README.md, crate at 48d97d06): #465 is wire. No check exists: workflowStatus is a free Option<String>; neither 'in the list's workflowStatuses' nor 'progress MUST be null' is enforced. The issue proposes invalidProperties for both-set and for a value not in workflowStatuses, and leaves open: mirror an RFC 8984 value into progress, or drop the MUST-null rule. Needs Mark's pick.
Mark 2026-11-19, decision 42: mirror. Standard RFC 8984 value in workflowStatus -> server sets progress (and progressUpdated) to it; other values -> progress null. progress set to a different value alongside workflowStatus -> invalidProperties; workflowStatus not in the list's workflowStatuses -> invalidProperties; list workflowStatuses changes leave tasks alone; a move to a list lacking the value -> invalidProperties naming workflowStatus unless the update also sets one the list has or null. Unblocked.
